forbidden_inline_truth_fields.task_register_snapshot: Recursive plan records may not embed mutable task-register snapshots.
forbidden_inline_truth_fields.task_records: Recursive plan records may not inline task truth that belongs to canonical task storage.
forbidden_inline_truth_fields.job_receipts: Recursive plan records may not duplicate full job receipts inline.
forbidden_inline_truth_fields.receipt_payloads: Recursive plan records may not carry receipt bodies instead of durable refs.
forbidden_inline_truth_fields.run_record: Recursive plan records may not embed canonical run records.
forbidden_inline_truth_fields.transcript_summary: Transcript summaries may explain recursive planning history but never replace durable plan truth.

forbidden_node_inline_fields.task_snapshot: Plan nodes may not embed task snapshots.
forbidden_node_inline_fields.task_record: Plan nodes may not embed full task records.
forbidden_node_inline_fields.receipt_payload: Plan nodes may not embed receipt payload bodies.
forbidden_node_inline_fields.run_payload: Plan nodes may not embed run payload bodies.
forbidden_node_inline_fields.transcript_summary: Plan nodes may not rely on transcript summaries as canonical truth.

ancestry_path_rule.root_rule: root node uses declared_depth=0 and ancestry_path=[]
ancestry_path_rule.non_root_rule: non-root ancestry_path begins at root_node_id and ends at parent_node_id

dependency_edge_rules: dependency edges must use explicit from_node_id and to_node_id endpoints
dependency edges must target declared node_id values
edge kind vocabulary stays explicit and closed in v1
append_only_expectations: plan writes append durable plan_event_refs instead of mutating hidden status history
plan writes carry a durable budget_adaptive_receipt instead of burying wave caps and continuation posture in transient validation-only state
node writes append node_event_refs instead of relying on prompt memory
recursive plan records group lower-layer truth and do not replace ledger, campaign, run, or receipt stores
